1: // Simple arcade game based on IDEA.md
2: // Targets a <canvas id="game"></canvas> element in the page.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const resize = () => {
12:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
13:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
14:   };
15:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
16:   resize();
17: 
18:   // ----- Game state -------------------------------------------------------
19:   const ship = {
20:     x: canvas.width / 2,
21:     y: canvas.height / 2,
22:     radius: 12,
23:     angle: 0, // radians, 0 points up
24:     vx: 0,
25:     vy: 0,
26:     thrust: 0.15,
27:     turnSpeed: Math.PI / 60,
28:     fuel: 100,
29:     maxFuel: 100,
30:     fuelBurn: 0.04,
31:     fuelGain: 20,
32:   };
33: 
34:   const asteroids = [];
35:   const pickups = [];
36:   const maxAsteroids = 8;
37:   const asteroidMinDist = 80; // distance from center to start orbit
38:   const asteroidSpeed = 0.005; // radians per frame
39:   const pickupSpawnInterval = 5000; // ms
40:   let lastPickupTime = 0;
41:   let gameOver = false;
42:   let score = 0;
43: 
44:   // ----- Input ------------------------------------------------------------
45:   const keys = {};
46:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
47:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
48: 
49:   // ----- Helper functions -------------------------------------------------
50:   const dist = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => Math.hypot(x1 - x2, y1 - y2);
51: 
52:   function spawnAsteroid() {
53:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
54:     const distFromCenter = asteroidMinDist + Math.random() * 150;
55:     const x = canvas.width / 2 + Math.cos(angle) * distFromCenter;
56:     const y = canvas.height / 2 + Math.sin(angle) * distFromCenter;
57:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
58:     const orbitRadius = distFromCenter;
59:     const orbitAngle = angle;
60:     const orbitSpeed = asteroidSpeed * (0.5 + Math.random());
61:     asteroids.push({ x, y, radius, orbitRadius, orbitAngle, orbitSpeed });
62:   }
63: 
64:   function spawnPickup() {
65:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
66:     const radius = 8;
67:     const distFromCenter = asteroidMinDist + Math.random() * 150;
68:     const x = canvas.width / 2 + Math.cos(angle) * distFromCenter;
69:     const y = canvas.height / 2 + Math.sin(angle) * distFromCenter;
70:     pickups.push({ x, y, radius, collected: false });
71:   }
72: 
73:   // Initialize asteroids
74:   for (let i = 0; i < maxAsteroids; i++) spawnAsteroid();
75: 
76:   // ----- Game loop --------------------------------------------------------
77:   function update(dt) {
78:     if (gameOver) return;
79: 
80:     // Input handling
81:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.turnSpeed;
82:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.turnSpeed;
83:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0) {
84:       ship.vx += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
85:       ship.vy -= Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
86:       ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - ship.fuelBurn);
87:     }
88: 
89:     // Move ship
90:     ship.x += ship.vx;
91:     ship.y += ship.vy;
92:     // wrap around edges
93:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += canvas.width;
94:     if (ship.x > canvas.width) ship.x -= canvas.width;
95:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += canvas.height;
96:     if (ship.y > canvas.height) ship.y -= canvas.height;
97: 
98:     // Asteroid orbit update
99:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
100:       a.orbitAngle += a.orbitSpeed;
101:       a.x = canvas.width / 2 + Math.cos(a.orbitAngle) * a.orbitRadius;
102:       a.y = canvas.height / 2 + Math.sin(a.orbitAngle) * a.orbitRadius;
103:     });
104: 
105:     // Collision detection
106:     for (const a of asteroids) {
107:       if (dist(ship.x, ship.y, a.x, a.y) < ship.radius + a.radius) {
108:         gameOver = true;
109:         break;
110:       }
111:     }
112:     // Pickups
113:     const now = Date.now();
114:     if (now - lastPickupTime > pickupSpawnInterval) {
115:       spawnPickup();
116:       lastPickupTime = now;
117:     }
118:     for (const p of pickups) {
119:       if (!p.collected && dist(ship.x, ship.y, p.x, p.y) < ship.radius + p.radius) {
120:         p.collected = true;
121:         ship.fuel = Math.min(ship.maxFuel, ship.fuel + ship.fuelGain);
122:         score += 10;
123:       }
124:     }
125:     // Fuel depletion loss
126:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
127:   }
128: 
129:   function draw() {
130:     // Clear
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
132:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
133: 
134:     // Ship
135:     ctx.save();
136:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
137:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
138:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
139:     ctx.beginPath();
140:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.radius);
141:     ctx.lineTo(ship.radius / 2, ship.radius);
142:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius / 2, ship.radius);
143:     ctx.closePath();
144:     ctx.fill();
145:     ctx.restore();
146: 
147:     // Asteroids
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
149:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
150:       ctx.beginPath();
151:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
152:       ctx.fill();
153:     });
154: 
155:     // Pickups
156:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
157:     pickups.forEach(p => {
158:       if (p.collected) return;
159:       ctx.beginPath();
160:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
161:       ctx.fill();
162:     });
163: 
164:     // HUD
165:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
166:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
167:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.round(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 20);
168:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 40);
169:     if (gameOver) {
170:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
171:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
172:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
173:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
174:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
175:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
176:     }
177:   }
178: 
179:   let lastTime = 0;
180:   function loop(timestamp) {
181:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
182:     lastTime = timestamp;
183:     update(dt);
184:     draw();
185:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
186:   }
187:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
188: })();

(End of file - total 188 lines)
